description.value:
A shotgun does not ask what you are wearing. At this distance armour is not protection, it is a decision about which way the damage goes — through the plate and into the ribs, or nowhere at all and straight into the meat. You want them close, because at the last ten feet none of their preparation means anything.

SIGNATURE — At close range you hit through armour, and what you leave behind depends on what they were wearing.
